label: VERIFIED
extraction: Kimi K2 (Moonshot AI) is an open-source agentic model with 1T total parameters, 32B active MoE architecture. Two variants: Kimi-K2-Base (foundation for fine-tuning) and Kimi-K2-Instruct (post-trained for chat/agentic use). Agentic capabilities from large-scale agentic data synthesis (ACEBench-inspired pipeline) and general reinforcement learning. Supports 17+ seamless tool calls (search, calendar, Gmail, flights, Airbnb, restaurant bookings). Edits files, runs commands on command line. SWE-bench Verified: 65.8%, SWE-bench Multilingual: 47.3%, Tau2-bench: 66.1%, AceBench (en): 80.1%, AIME 2025: 49.5%. Modified MIT License. Vision features not yet supported. MCP features for web/app in development. Available free on web/mobile; API via platform.moonshot.ai.
